title: Add stability-curator: signal aggregator + changelog abbreviator
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: we frequently onboard model variants where the telemetry signal is noisy and release changelogs are verbose. This PR implements a lightweight stability curator service that aggregates sampled workload telemetry, computes a weighted regression-based destabilization score per variant, and emits a concise, human-readable changelog blurb for release notes. The goal is to automate the first-pass impact summary so engineers can triage regressions faster and product teams get a predictable summary for release pages.

What this change does (high level): implements a new microservice (services/stability-curator) that consumes the model telemetry stream (sampled events via telemetry-ingest), stores short-lived summary fingerprints in a new stability_signals table, computes a per-variant "instability score" using traffic-weighted linear regression over the last 7 days, and exposes an HTTP preview API used by an on-demand CLI (cmd/registry-digest) to render a 2–3 line release blurb. The change also adds a changelog abbreviator library (pkg/registry/changelog) that selects top-3 impacted routes and formats severity tags (low/medium/high) with suggested remediation hints.

Design notes: instability score = weighted combination of relative-latency-delta, failure-rate-delta, and quality-delta (where quality-delta is derived from eval-set regressions uploaded during model onboarding). Traffic weights come from sampled request counts per route. The service keeps a TTL of 14 days for raw summaries and writes 1h-aggregates to the DB for reproducibility. The abbreviator attempts to keep blurb length under 240 characters and includes a linkable fingerprint for traceability.

Files added/changed: see files_changed. Includes a DB migration (migrations/2024-10-29_add_stability_signals.sql), service skeleton and core scoring logic (Go), unit and integration tests, a small CLI preview, and docs for registry maintainers.

Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature-flag registry.stability_curator.enabled. Feature flag defaults to off. We will enable for the model-registry canary org first, validate blurb quality, then open beta for internal teams. There is an opt-out per-variant annotation to suppress automated blurbs.

Testing and validation: added deterministic unit tests for the regression scorer with synthetic workloads, an integration test that replays a sampled telemetry fixture, and an electable canary pipeline change in ci/pipelines/stability-curator.yaml.

Migration: the SQL migration creates a small table (sharded by model_id) and an index on (variant_id, window_start). The data footprint is expected to be modest because we only store aggregates and we TTL raw rows. See docs/onboarding/stability-curator.md for retention guidance.
commits_summary: 3 logical commits: (1) scaffold service, API and migration; (2) implement regression scorer, prioritizer and abbreviator lib; (3) tests, docs and CI pipeline. The squash at merge condenses some intermediate WIP commits. Key change IDs included in each commit message for auditability.
review_conversation: Diego Marquez (review): Nice direction — can you clarify how the traffic weights are computed from sampled telemetry? Also please ensure we don't double-count cached prefix hits in the counts.

Author (Aisha): We sample at the ingress with a deterministic sampler keyed on request_id, and counts are de-duplicated for cache hits by checking response metadata.cache_hit. Updated tests and code to subtract cache hits from weights.

Sophie Chen (review): The regression implementation looks fine but please add a safety floor for low-traffic variants (we risk false positives). Can we also surface the raw deltas in the preview API for inspection?

Author (Aisha): Added a minimum-sample threshold (default 200 requests in window) and exposed raw delta payload in preview (preview=false toggles the compact blurb). Documented the threshold in the onboarding doc.
Liam O'Connor (suggestion): Add an opt-out annotation for variants that are intentionally unstable (A/B experiments).
Author (Aisha): Added variant annotation registry.experimental: true which suppresses automated blurbs. Updated tests and docs.
Sophie Chen (approve): Approved after small nits fixed.
Diego Marquez (approve): Approved — CI rerun required due to a transient integration flake.
release_notes:
- Add Stability Curator service to aggregate telemetry and surface automated short-form release blurbs (opt-in via feature flag).
- New DB migration stability_signals for 1h aggregate storage.
- CLI preview command: registry-digest to render blurb locally.
- Opt-out annotation for experimental variants.
(Usage: enable registry.stability_curator.enabled and run registry-digest --preview <variant-id> to inspect generated blurb.)
